stage.name: New Hotel Avenue
stage.description:
Tourists never stay here, but they do leave with its song and wine. They even want to take with them those soft and fluffy dreams, but those have already melted away in yesterday's evening breeze. Do you see those fluffy creatures? Let's chase after them together, one more time.
<Condition>DP will not regenerate naturally
<Decorative Geyser>Units standing around it are unaffected by vapor, and will produce White Vapor when attacking
<Steam Soda Bottles>When defeated, creates Pure White Steam in the surrounding area

hot_spring_mischievous_rascal.name: Hot Spring 'Mischievous Rascal'
hot_spring_mischievous_rascal.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice on the street, and wants to play with whoever it bumps into. Even though you can't make out its expression from its obscured face, you can sense it in its revelry.
abilities: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

fashion_street_hearty_heavy.name: Fashion Street 'Hearty Heavy'
fashion_street_hearty_heavy.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the sports field. It'll be really happy if you throw its 'treasure' back at it. Thankfully, it only throws frisbees, and not discuses.
abilities: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

hot_spring_wandering_vagrant.name: Hot Spring 'Wandering Vagrant'
hot_spring_wandering_vagrant.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the surfskate shop, so fast that it comes and goes without a trace! It's practicing its acceleration and turning for the upcoming 'Lava Surfing Championships.'
abilities: Invisible
Can stack with a Hot Spring 'Mischievous Rascal' and leaves Carmine Steam on tiles it travels over after combining

urban_whirlwind_walker.name: Urban 'Whirlwind Walker'
urban_whirlwind_walker.flavourText: A mass of fluffy critters fighting over cotton candy, and it's a little hard to tell where the fur ends and where the candyfloss begins. The main reason the Candy House grandpa is so angry is because they snatched his wig off too!
abilities: Explodes on first attack, dealing AoE Arts damage and spawning Carmine Steam
Summons a Hot Spring 'Mischievous Rascal' and Fashion Street 'Hearty Heavy' upon dying

fluffy_buddy.name: 'Fluffy Buddy'
fluffy_buddy.flavourText: If these gentle and difficult-to-perceive fluffy critters suddenly appear in front of you, don't be frightened! In the hot springs, atop the white clouds, and in your memories... Will you still think of them years down the line?
abilities: Hidden in map, can be revealed by Carmine Steam or Pure White Steam
When in contact with Carmine Steam, its explosion produces more Carmine Steam on surrounding tiles and dealing Arts damage to nearby allied units
When in contact with Pure White Steam, its explosion produces more Pure White Steam on surrounding tiles and healing surrounding allied units

fashion_street_ordinary_aviator.name: Fashion Street 'Ordinary Aviator'
fashion_street_ordinary_aviator.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the aviation shop. It can fly, but it's not very good at it. Sometimes it can float up real high, but don't mistake it for a pink cloud!
abilities: Low-Altitude Hovering
Can stack with a Fashion Street 'Hearty Heavy' and is capable of long-range attacks after combining

fashion_street_stellar_caster.name: Fashion Street 'Stellar Caster'
fashion_street_stellar_caster.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from a mysterious divination shop that will make anyone who notices it 'see stars'! It's very clever, and knows that the next most important thing after a wand is the magic hat on its head!
abilities: Attacks 3 units simultaneously when in contact with Carmine Steam

big_fella.name: 'Big Fella'
big_fella.flavourText: A humongous and somewhat slow-moving fluffy critter, its sturdiness possibly stems from never picking at its food. Sometimes it will spit out a few 'Little Fellas'—they might have been eaten by accident earlier.
abilities: Throws a Hot Spring 'Mischievous Rascal' on first attack

dolly_sovereign_of_sheep.name: Dolly, Sovereign of Sheep
dolly_sovereign_of_sheep.flavourText: Sovereign of Sheep, traveling through the barrenlands and enjoying lava surfing. He sees everyone as equals, and is happy to leave their 'mark' on this great land. Now, it's time to have some fun with him!
abilities: Unblockable; permanently in Low-Altitude Hovering

[Wool Barrier] Physical and Arts damage taken is significantly reduced when the Barrier is active. When Barrier value reaches 0, Dolly will lose his Barrier and fall, losing Low-Altitude Hovering and becoming disarmed.
Barrier value can be significantly reduced by Steam Soda Bottle explosions.
Dolly loses Barrier value when taking damage from Operators standing around a Decorative Geyser.
Airy Dolly
Prioritizes attacking ground units, and applies Carmine Steam on tiles the targets are on

[Elated Firebreathing] Locks onto a unit, and afterwards lets loose a vertical line of fire on that target's location from top to bottom, dealing Arts damage to all units on tiles in that column and generating Carmine Steam on the tiles
[Unintentional Explosion] Stops attacking to charge energy. After a period of time, ignites all Carmine Steam from right to left, dealing Arts and Burn to all targets in range
Frantic Dolly
Cannot attack, leaves Carmine Steam on tiles it travels over
Deals Arts damage and Burn to units he bumps into
Dolly no longer uses [Elated Firebreathing], and will only use [Unintentional Explosion] upon making landfall
